expectation.stresses: A large Azure module whose exports are cmdlets implemented in C#, not functions written in PowerShell. Nothing the parser looks for is present in the source it can read.
expectation.predicted: Succeeds with a near-empty node set and no error at all: the manifest declares dozens of exports and the graph reports a handful of nodes or none. This is the empty-graph-with-no-error case, deliberately included. Predicted as a parser defect rather than a property of the module, because a graph that reports nothing must be able to say why.
